$description: Devot primitives. Themes reference these; components use theme tokens only.

foreground.$description: The glyph on a coloured icon tile: white, except where the tile is light.

foreground-contrast.$description: The glyph on the yellow icon tile, which white would disappear into.

brand.$description: The app icon and the logo (design/app-icon/): artwork only, never the UI. A name ending in -dark is the dark appearance; the effects (the glow, highlights and shadows) are these colours at an opacity the artwork sets.

tile-top-dark.$description: The dark tile's top: color.night.0 lifted, so the tile reads as a raised surface.

glow.$description: The faint glow behind the dove, in both appearances.

dove-middle.$description: Also the dove in one colour: the favicon and the Icon Composer layer's own fill.

dove-bottom.$description: Also the soft shadow under the dove.

dove-top-dark.$description: The dark dove's top: color.teal.300 lifted toward the light.

dove-bottom-dark.$description: The dark dove's bottom: between color.teal.300 and color.teal.500.

highlight.$description: The tile's sheen and top rim, the dove's top edge, and the dove in the tinted and clear appearances, where the system colours it.

shadow.$description: Drop shadows: under the tile, and under the dove in the dark appearance.

destructive-dark.$description: Destructive labels in the dark appearance: light enough to read on a raised button face.

purple-light.$description: The Important alert, light: purple text that keeps 4.5:1 on the editor.

ui.$description: The system font. On macOS its own fallback picks the CJK face for the text's language; elsewhere (an exported page) the CJK faces of font.family.cjk follow before the generic family, so Chinese never falls back to a Japanese or mismatched face.

mono.$description: SF Mono (ui-monospace on macOS), then the CJK faces of font.family.cjk before the generic family: monospaced faces carry no CJK, and the generic one would pick any face.

cjk.$description: The CJK faces every family falls back to before its generic family (Simplified Chinese forms): macOS, then Windows, then Linux.

caption2.$description: The smallest text: tag pills in the note list.

note-title.$description: The open note's title, above its notebook, status and tags.

list-title.$description: The note list header's view name, on one line.

note.$description: Note text: the preview, and exported and printed pages. One body line sets the vertical rhythm and headings follow one modular scale, so every block sits on the same steps at any preview size.

body.$description: Body text, and the length of one body line (the rhythm's unit).

heading.$description: Headings: tighter than the body, as large type needs less room between lines.

rhythm.$description: Vertical space in body lines, in quarter-line steps: rhythm.N is N quarters of a line.

1.$description: Under a small heading; between a list item's paragraphs.

2.$description: Between paragraphs and other text blocks; under the two top headings.

3.$description: Around boxed blocks: code, tables, framed images, math and diagrams.

4.$description: Over the small headings (h4 to h6); around a rule.

6.$description: Over a second-level heading; over the footnotes.

heading.$description: Heading sizes in em of the body text: the major third (1.25) to the power 3, 2, 1, 0, -0.5 and -1.

size.$description: Inline sizes in em of the text around them.

code.$description: Code, inline and in blocks: monospaced faces run wide and tall, so they set smaller to match the body's weight on the line.

script.$description: Superscripts and subscripts, footnote numbers among them.

underline-offset.$description: How far under the text a link's underline sits, in em: clear of the letters, near enough to read as theirs.

settings-card.$description: A Settings card, a theme swatch and an Interface style thumbnail.

settings-tile.$description: The coloured icon tile in the Settings sidebar.

mark.$description: Inline code chips and the box around tables in the editor.

pill.$description: Tag pills in the note list.

popover.$description: Floating lists in the editor: the slash menu and the completion popups.

floating-bar.$description: The selection toolbar and the image size bar.

sidebar.$description: Glass interface: the floating sidebar, concentric with the window's corner at size.sidebar-inset from its edge.

sidebar-row.$description: Glass interface: a sidebar row's highlight, concentric with radius.sidebar at size.sidebar-inset.

list-row.$description: Glass interface: a note row's highlight, inset from the list's edges.

note-info.$description: Glass interface: the note info card.

glass-popover.$description: Glass interface: popovers, pickers and page-drawn menus. Concentric with radius.glass-menu-row at size.glass-popover-inset.

glass-floating-bar.$description: Glass interface: the selection toolbar and the image size bar.

glass-dialog.$description: Glass interface: sheets, alerts, the link dialog and the palette. Concentric with radius.glass-group and a 28 px capsule at size.glass-dialog-inset, and with a 40 px capsule at size.glass-palette-inset.

glass-group.$description: Glass interface: an inset group inside a dialog, concentric with radius.glass-dialog at size.glass-dialog-inset.

glass-menu-row.$description: Glass interface: a row or search field in a popover, concentric with radius.glass-popover at size.glass-popover-inset.

glass-tooltip.$description: Glass interface: a tooltip, which stands alone and has no inset child.

window.$description: The system's window corner, not drawn by the app: documents the rule. Concentric with radius.sidebar at size.sidebar-inset.

glass-card.$description: Glass Settings cards and picture choices, concentric with the floating navigation.

settings-nav-row.$description: A row in the Settings window's sidebar.

settings-row.$description: A Settings row whose label sits on one line.

settings-row-sub.$description: A Settings row with a description under its label.

settings-tile.$description: The coloured icon tile before a Settings sidebar row's name.

settings-control.$description: A capsule control in Settings: the search field, Back and Forward, pop-ups, buttons, segmented controls and steppers.

settings-swatch-width.$description: A theme swatch in Settings > Appearance.

settings-thumb-width.$description: A Color scheme, Interface style or Icon style thumbnail in Settings > Appearance.

settings-key-field.$description: The key field of a Settings > Keyboard row: one width for every row, so they line up.

settings-field.$description: A text field in Settings (URLs, models, keys, codes): one width in every pane, with any buttons under it spanning the same width.

sidebar-width.$description: The sidebar's width until the user drags its right edge.

sidebar-min-width.$description: The narrowest the sidebar is dragged or clamped to when the window is narrow.

sidebar-max-width.$description: The widest the sidebar is dragged to.

list-min-width.$description: The narrowest the note list is dragged or shrinks to when the window is narrow.

list-default-width.$description: The note list's width until the user drags its right edge.

list-max-width.$description: The widest the note list is dragged to.

board-min-width.$description: The narrowest the note list is dragged or shrinks to while it shows a board.

board-default-width.$description: The board's width until the user drags its right edge: room for its five columns at their narrowest.

board-max-width.$description: The widest the board is dragged to; the editor keeps its minimum.

board-editor-min-width.$description: The narrowest the editor gets beside a board: its toolbar, title and metadata row fit without clipping. The board scrolls sideways before the editor goes below it.

board-column-min-width.$description: The narrowest a board column gets; narrower boards scroll sideways. Five fit the board's default width.

pane-resize-handle.$description: The strip on a resizable pane's right edge (sidebar, note list) that resizes it.

list-focus-bar.$description: The bar on the left edge of the note row that has the keyboard.

list-row-inset.$description: A note row's text inset from its left and right edges.

drag-card-min-width.$description: The narrowest the card under the pointer is while notes are dragged.

drag-card-max-width.$description: The widest the card under the pointer is while notes are dragged.

pane-min-width.$description: The narrowest a split-mode pane (source or preview) gets; the panes scroll sideways before they go below it.

sidebar-collapse-width.$description: A window narrower than this hides the sidebar until it is asked for (the sidebar, a shrunken list and the editor's toolbar no longer fit together).

window-controls-inset.$description: Where a toolbar's first control starts when the window controls sit over it (the note list's while the sidebar is hidden, the editor's in focus mode): the controls start 20 px in (trafficLightPosition in tauri.conf.json) and end at 74 px (three 14 px buttons 6 px apart), then the sidebar's own 10 px edge padding.

sidebar-toggle-width.$description: The width of the sidebar toggle in the note list's header.

popup-max-width.$description: The widest a pop-up button grows; a longer name is cut off with an ellipsis.

settings-nav-width.$description: The width of the Settings window's navigation column.

sidebar-row.$description: Every sidebar row: views, filters, tags, notebooks and the footer; rows sit one after the other with no gap.

dialog-row.$description: A row of a list in a dialog or pop-up (the move picker, the command palette, backups, history, templates, import problems).

view-segment-width.$description: A view-mode segment in the editor toolbar.

view-segment-height.$description: The height of a view-mode segment in the editor toolbar.

icon-lg.$description: A Settings toolbar tab's symbol and a pane toolbar button's.

image-small.$description: The width of an image set to Small in the preview.

inline-image-height.$description: The height of an image shown under its line in the editor (fixed, so lines never move as images load).

scroll-edge.$description: Glass note content fades over this distance below its header after scrolling.

scrollbar.$description: The width of a scroll bar.

menu-width.$description: The slash menu's width with every item listed; a filtered list shrinks to its rows.

menu-max-height.$description: How tall a completion list grows (eight and a half rows) before it scrolls.

menu-row.$description: A row of the slash menu.

icon-menu.$description: A row icon in the slash menu.

float-notch-width.$description: The notch of a floating bar: its width (the tip is centred on the anchor).

float-notch-height.$description: The notch of a floating bar: how far it reaches out of the bar.

focus-ring.$description: The width of the focus ring on custom controls; it sits on the control's edge (offset 0).

drop-indicator.$description: The line between rows where a dragged row will go, and the dashed outline of a notebook a drag goes into.

picker-min-width.$description: The narrowest a dropdown list is.

notice-text-min-width.$description: The narrowest the text of a notice above the editor gets; past it, the notice's buttons wrap below the text.

notice-max-width.$description: The widest a notice at the bottom of the window gets; longer text wraps.

picker-min-height.$description: A dropdown list is as tall as half the window, but never shorter than this (it scrolls past it).

popover-margin.$description: The least space between a dropdown list and the window edge.

switch-width.$description: An on/off switch: the lane width.

switch-height.$description: An on/off switch: the lane height; the knob is this less twice the inset.

switch-inset.$description: An on/off switch: the gap between the knob and the lane edge.

float-separator-height.$description: The divider between a floating bar's button groups: its height.

filter-field-height.$description: The note list's Filter field: its 34px bar less a 2px margin above and below.

filter-icon-slot.$description: The Filter field's icon slot (the funnel at rest, the clear button with a query): the text starts after it.

sidebar-inset.$description: Glass interface: the room between the floating sidebar and the window's edges and the note list, and between the sidebar's edge and its rows.

glass-dialog-inset.$description: Glass interface: the padding where groups and buttons meet a dialog's edge; radius.glass-dialog minus this is radius.glass-group.

glass-dialog-button.$description: Glass interface: a dialog's capsule button; half of this plus size.glass-dialog-inset is radius.glass-dialog.

glass-dialog-row.$description: Glass interface: a row of an inset group in a dialog.

glass-badge.$description: Glass interface: a tinted capsule badge in a dialog row.

glass-palette-inset.$description: Glass interface: the padding inside the palette; radius.glass-dialog minus this is half of its 40 px field.

glass-popover-inset.$description: Glass interface: the padding inside a popover; radius.glass-popover minus this is radius.glass-menu-row.

list-inset.$description: Glass interface: how far note rows sit in from the list's edges.

toolbar-control.$description: Glass interface: the height of a toolbar control, and a round toolbar button's width.

glass-switch-width.$description: Glass switch track width, allowing a capsule handle.

motion.$description: How things move: hover, toggles, colour changes and pop-ups each have one duration, and Reduce Motion drops every movement (app.css).

color.$description: A colour change that should be noticed rather than seen: a floating bar button's text, a theme switch across the panes.

ring.$description: A floating bar button's outline ring coming and going (the toggle duration).

popover.$description: A pop-up (bar, menu, tooltip) growing out of its notch or anchor as it fades in; a menu unfolding to its height.

fade.$description: A floating bar (the selection toolbar, the image size bar) or the editor's floating actions fading in or out.

slide.$description: Panes moving to where a hidden or shown sidebar leaves them (and the toolbar items that make room for the window controls with them), the sidebar fading as it goes or comes, its rows sliding to and from a workspace, and its notebooks and tags coming, going and moving. About as long as the move curve's spring takes to settle.

hover.$description: A control's fill and colour coming and going under the pointer or a press: note list rows, toolbar buttons, segments, chips, menu rows.

toggle.$description: A two-state change: a disclosure chevron turning, a section opening, a selection bar or focus ring appearing.

dialog.$description: A modal dialog growing and fading in, or blurring and fading out.

backdrop.$description: The dim behind a modal dialog fading in.

icon.$description: An icon in a field fading in or out with the field's focus.

quick.$description: A change that should feel immediate: a sidebar row under the pointer, a focus ring arriving.

insert.$description: A note list row fading in or out as it comes or goes, while the rows after it slide.

grow.$description: A size change: the image viewer resizing, a progress bar filling, the backlinks opening, a tag chip arriving, a code block's copy button showing.

backdrop-exit.$description: The dim behind a modal dialog fading out as it closes.

move.$description: Everything that moves, grows or turns: a critically damped spring (no overshoot) drawn as a curve. It is already moving fast in its first frame, so a change answers at once, and settles softly.

quick.$description: A quick start that settles softly (CSS ease).

popover-enter.$description: The size a pop-up starts at before growing to full size.

popover-exit.$description: The size a pop-up shrinks to, toward its notch or anchor, as it fades out.

dialog-enter.$description: The size a modal dialog starts at before growing to full size.

chip-enter.$description: The size a tag chip starts at as it is added.

press.$description: Glass interface: the size a toolbar control shrinks to while it is pressed, springing back on release.

delay.$description: How long something waits before it shows.

tooltip.$description: The pointer resting on a toolbar button before its tooltip shows; it hides at once when the pointer leaves or presses.

idle-hide.$description: The editor's floating actions fade away once the pointer and the keyboard have rested this long.

dialog.$description: How blurred a modal dialog is as it fades in and out.

shadow.$description: The two-layer shadow under pop-ups; its colours are the theme's color.shadow tokens.

float-bar-blur.$description: The soft single shadow under a floating bar (the selection toolbar, the image size bar); its colour is color.shadow.float-bar.

tooltip.$description: A tooltip bubble's placement: it sits above its button (below only when there is no room), and stays inside the window.

gap.$description: Between the button and the bubble's edge (the notch points across it).

edge.$description: The least space kept between the bubble and the window's edge.

arrow-inset.$description: The least distance from the notch's centre to the bubble's corner.

opacity.$description: How strongly a colour shows: tag chips mix their tag colour with transparent at these strengths, in both appearances.

disabled.$description: A control that cannot be used.

dragged.$description: A row while it is being dragged.

list-selected.$description: A selected note row's background: the accent fill at this strength.

card-selected.$description: A selected board card's background: the accent fill at this strength over the card fill. Lighter than a row's, as the card already sits on a column's track and its text must keep 4.5:1.

fill.$description: A tag chip's background: its tag colour at this strength.

fill-active.$description: A tag chip's background under the pointer or pressed.

border-active.$description: A tag chip's edge under the pointer or pressed.

dot.$description: A tag colour dot's fill; its edge is the solid tag colour.

filter-icon.$description: The Filter field's funnel at rest; it shows fully while the field has the keyboard.

headline-icon.$description: The icon before the note list header's view name, on the name's colour.
